words: Love Oct 29 2026 2:19 PM PT: "and stage a push to github after every revision , every command prompt i click myself please. she needs to be updated that moment, and able to be reverted back to previous settings at a moments notice. pls and ty"
what: Every commit from a CHANGE or REVERT Love clicks is pushed to her private GitHub that moment (.git/hooks/post-commit, 5 tries with backoff, PUSH-HER-NOW.command if the internet was down). REVERT-HER.command puts her code, tools, guards and settings back to any earlier version as a new version (request book, exit log and LIVE on/off kept). SETUP-GITHUB.command connects her once.
